This recipe is based on a macaroni and cheese recipe, with additions of meat and vegetables to promote it from a side dish to a main course.

==Ingredients==
* 250 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]]) [[Cookbook:Macaroni|macaroni]]
* 30 g (1 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounce]]) [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 45 g (3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]]) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 240 ml (1 cup) [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* [[Cookbook:salt|Salt]] to taste
* [[Cookbook:pepper|Pepper]] to taste
* 140 g (5 ounces) shredded [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]] (e.g. [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar]], [[Cookbook:Emmental Cheese|emmental]], [[Cookbook:Gruyère Cheese|gruyère]] or whatever you like)
* 2 [[Cookbook:Hot Dog|hot dogs]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* 140 g (5 ounces) frozen green vegetables (e.g. [[Cookbook:spinach|spinach]], [[Cookbook:Kale|kale]], [[Cookbook:Broccoli|broccoli]], [[Cookbook:Peas|peas]], or whatever you like)
* 2 fresh [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], sliced
* Grated [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]]
* [[Cookbook:Paprika|Paprika]]

==Procedure==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 180°C (350°F) and grease a casserole or [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]].
# On the stovetop, bring 2 [[Cookbook:Liter|liters]] (2 [[Cookbook:Quart|quarts]]) of salted water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]; add the macaroni and cook for 9 minutes or until [[Cookbook:Al Dente|al dente]].
# While the macaroni is cooking, start making the [[Cookbook:Roux|roux]]. Mix the flour and butter in a saucepan and heat over low heat, stirring until blended and bubbling.
# Add the milk, salt and pepper and stir until thickened. Reduce heat to the lowest setting and add the cheese, sliced hotdogs, and frozen vegetables.
# When the macaroni is done, drain and put in the greased dish. Pour the sauce over the noodles and stir till combined.
# Arrange the tomato slices on top, then sprinkle grated parmesan and paprika over the tomato slices.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 40 minutes.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* Instead of the hot dogs, you can use any other meat you like: [[Cookbook:Ground Beef|ground beef]] (browned in a skillet first), bite-sized pieces of cooked [[Cookbook:chicken|chicken]], canned [[Cookbook:tuna|tuna]], and so on. For a vegetarian version, try diced [[Cookbook:tofu|tofu]], [[Cookbook:Textured Vegetable Protein|textured vegetable protein]] (soy meat), [[Cookbook:Chickpea|chickpeas]], [[Cookbook:Lentil|brown lentils]], etc.

* [[Cookbook:Macaroni and Cheese|Macaroni and Cheese]]
